title: Prune observer-irrelevant provenance materialization in the canonical relation compiler

masterplan.gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

issue_scope.priority: implement the bounded GPU-50 Gardener target by removing observer-irrelevant provenance work from Boolean/natural compilation without adding a parallel compiler, fact store, cache, backend or registry

implementation.summary: The existing compile_relation_blocks owner now selects provenance retention from the canonical observer name. Evidence-DAG continues to materialize canonical Forest edge and verified-binding witness bundles. Boolean and natural observers record only the semantic coordinate key and pass no evidence atoms into the existing fact map, so _forest_edge_atoms and verified-binding digest/evidence tuple construction are avoided when those values cannot affect the scalar block.
implementation.gardener_note: The existing fact map and _record_fact owner are reused. _record_fact now accepts optional evidence atoms and creates the same deduplicated semantic coordinate even when provenance is absent. No second fact representation, compiler, cache, evidence store, helper subsystem, backend, registry or public API was introduced.
implementation.semantic_boundary: Boolean remains True and natural remains unit 1 per deduplicated semantic coordinate; duplicate ingestion/evidence witnesses do not become natural multiplicity. Evidence-DAG retains canonical alternative evidence bundles. Endpoint completeness, retained-hyperedge refusal, selected-signature pruning, discover-all selection, Forest/snapshot binding and source receipt counts remain in the same canonical compiler.
implementation.source_counts: forest_edge_count, forest_hyperedge_count and verified_binding_count continue to describe bound source cardinalities rather than observer-specific materialization work

focused_contracts: Boolean selected and discoverable facts are retained by semantic coordinate while selected Forest evidence does not call _forest_edge_atoms
natural selected facts likewise retain unit 1 per deduplicated semantic coordinate without Forest witness materialization
selected verified bindings under Boolean/natural enter the canonical fact map with no provenance bundle and retain verified_binding_count source cardinality
evidence-dag selected/discover-all compilation continues to materialize Forest evidence and retains canonical alternative witness bundles
selected-signature pruning, endpoint completeness refusal, retained-hyperedge refusal and source receipt counts remain regression-covered
